works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 柔和中性色配沉浸式美妆摄影，三屏并置把社交电商从浏览到购买的路径讲得很完整。
works.comment_en: Soft neutrals with immersive beauty photography; three screens side by side tell the full social-commerce path from browsing to buying.
works.title: Beauty E-Commerce Mobile App

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: 暖米色底加橙色点缀，AI 助手、扫码与热量仪表盘集中在一个清晰层级。
works.comment_en: Warm beige base with orange accents; AI assistant, scanning, and the calorie dashboard sit in one clear hierarchy.
works.title: AI Food Tracker App — Smart Nutrition & Calorie Tracking

works.author: Ibrahim Khalil
works.comment: 以“最需要关注什么”为核心的优先级队列，把事件、失败部署、安全发现与预算风险同屏呈现。
works.comment_en: A priority queue built around 'what needs attention most' — events, failed deploys, security findings, and budget risks on one screen.
works.title: CloudNexus: Cloud Operations Dashboard

works.author: NexUX Product
works.comment: 深色着陆页配 MRR/ARR/订阅数/流失率卡片，着陆页讲价值、仪表盘讲指标的转化结构清晰。
works.comment_en: Dark landing page with MRR/ARR/subscriber/churn cards — a clear conversion structure: the page sells value, the dashboard sells metrics.
works.title: SaaS Subscription & Revenue Analytics Website

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 深色移动仪表盘用双色柱状图拆分理论/实践时长，进度卡与总时长一目了然。
works.comment_en: Dark mobile dashboard splitting theory/practice hours with two-tone bars; progress cards and total time at a glance.
works.title: Learning Dashboard - Student Mobile Progress

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 强蓝色 Hero 配网格与圆环蓝图线条，把硬科技讲得乐观、精密且易懂。
works.comment_en: Bold blue hero with grid and blueprint ring lines — hard tech told optimistically, precisely, and legibly.
works.title: ordivalabs: Precision Biotech Laboratory Automation - Hero UIUX
